channel.title: ESP32 Engine
channel.description: Latest ESP32 project tutorials with wiring guides, Arduino code, and three skill levels.

item.title: Build an Isolated AC Current Monitor Prototype
item.description: Low-voltage SCT-013-030 and ESP32 current-sensing exercise: isolated 12 V AC source, GPIO34 bias network, EmonLib assumptions and measurement limits.

item.title: ESP32-CAM Color Object Detector Demo
item.description: Build an ESP32-CAM color object detector demo with AI-Thinker OV2640 wiring, RGB565 thresholding on the ESP32, LED output, privacy notes, and no ML model claims.

item.title: ESP32 MQ135 Raw Sensor Monitor
item.description: Build a bounded MQ135 bench demonstration: 5 V heater, 12k/10k ADC divider, conditioning, relative thresholds and explicit safety limitations.

item.title: ESP32 BLE Beacon and iBeacon Tutorial
item.description: Build an ESP32 BLE beacon and iBeacon demo with phone scanner testing, UUID, major/minor fields, RSSI behavior, and no extra hardware.

item.title: ESP32-CAM Face Detection Limits: Core 3.3.2 Camera Check
item.description: Understand why the reviewed CameraWebServer does not implement face detection, then check an AI-Thinker OV2640 camera with a complete Serial-only example.

item.title: ESP32-CAM QR Scanner: Quirc 1.2 Serial Decoding
item.description: Decode QR candidates locally with a defined AI-Thinker OV2640/PSRAM setup, Quirc 1.2 source files, checked grayscale buffers and length-bounded Serial output.

item.title: ESP32-CAM JPEG Capture Server: Local Snapshots
item.description: Serve one JPEG at /capture from an AI-Thinker OV2640 with Arduino-ESP32 3.3.2, explicit memory settings, bounded Wi-Fi attempts and qualified power/upload wiring.

item.title: Build a Low-Voltage CNC Motion Controller Demo
item.description: Build a bounded ESP32 CNC motion-control demo with A4988 STEP/DIR wiring, separate motor power, current-limit setup, and safety limits.

item.title: ESP32 Digital Piano
item.description: Build a classic ESP32 touch piano with eight capacitive pads and a passive piezo using Arduino-ESP32 3.x pin-based LEDC APIs. Plays one note at a time.

item.title: ESP32 Distance Monitoring System
item.description: Build an ESP32 HC-SR04 distance monitor with TRIG GPIO5, ECHO GPIO18 through a 10 kOhm / 20 kOhm divider, 5 V sensor power, distance code, and buzzer alert.

item.title: ESP32 AD8232 Bench Signal Viewer — No Electrodes
item.description: Read AD8232 output and leads-off flags on ESP32 with every electrode port disconnected. A USB bench acquisition demo, not a body-connected ECG.

item.title: ESP32 MQ-2 Threshold Demonstration
item.description: Build a bounded MQ-2 bench demonstration: 5 V heater, 12k/10k ADC divider, conditioning, relative thresholds and explicit safety limitations.

item.title: Build an APDS-9960 Gesture Control Demo
item.description: Build a technically honest ESP32 gesture demo with APDS-9960 I2C wiring, interrupt handling, LED outputs, and false-trigger limits.

item.title: Build a Local NEO-6M GPS Reader
item.description: Build an ESP32 NEO-6M GPS reader with UART wiring, TinyGPS++ parsing, no-fix handling, sky-view guidance, and location privacy limits.

item.title: Build a Low-Voltage Greenhouse Vent Controller
item.description: Build a safe ESP32 greenhouse ventilation prototype with DHT22 readings, OLED status, relay wiring, hysteresis, and low-voltage limits.

item.title: ESP32 Home Climate Automation
item.description: Build a room climate controller that reads environmental data and automatically controls a fan, vent, or humidifier indicator.

item.title: ESP32 BME280 Weather Node: Placement and Serial Checks
item.description: Check ESP32 BME280 placement, airflow and local Serial readings. Use the sensor setup guide first; OLED and networking are optional extensions.

item.title: ESP32 IR Remote Control: IRremote Receive and Send
item.description: Build an ESP32 IR remote with TSOP38238 receiver wiring, transistor IR LED driver, IRremote NEC receive/send code, line-of-sight testing, and safety limits.

item.title: ESP32 Learning Trainer Board
item.description: Classroom ESP32 trainer with a push button on GPIO27 and status LED on GPIO14.

item.title: ESP32 LED Matrix Display: MAX7219 Scrolling Text
item.description: Build an ESP32 MAX7219 scrolling display with 5 V power, 3.3-to-5 V logic buffering, MD_Parola setup, module orientation and brightness checks.

item.title: ESP32 Lightning Detector: AS3935 Sensor Demo
item.description: Build an ESP32 AS3935 lightning sensor demo with SPI wiring, interrupt handling, OLED output, noise/disturber classification, and official-alert safety limits.

item.title: ESP32 Line Following Robot
item.description: Build an ESP32 line following robot with two IR sensors, motor driver wiring, sensor calibration, steering logic, troubleshooting, and complete Arduino code.

item.title: ESP32 LoRa Remote Sensor Node (Point-to-Point)
item.description: Build a two-node ESP32 LoRa sensor link with real point-to-point radio, legal frequency checks, antenna safety, and packet validation.

item.title: ESP32 Machine Monitoring Node
item.description: Build a bench-safe ESP32 machine monitoring node with current-sensor input on GPIO35, relay module control on GPIO19, ADC threshold calibration, and safety limits.

item.title: ESP32 Motion Security Alert
item.description: Build an ESP32 PIR motion sensor project with HC-SR501 OUT on GPIO27, warm-up behavior, buzzer or LED alert logic, false-trigger fixes, and safety limits.

item.title: ESP32 MQTT DHT22 Sensor Publisher
item.description: Publish DHT22 readings to a local MQTT broker, subscribe to a sample command, use unique client IDs and diagnose reconnects. Plain TCP demonstration, not TLS.

item.title: ESP32 NeoPixel Music Visualizer (Amplitude-Reactive)
item.description: Build a real amplitude-reactive NeoPixel visualizer with an I2S digital microphone, external LED power, and honest no-FFT scope.

item.title: ESP32 OLED Weather Clock: BME280, Wi-Fi and Local Time
item.description: Build an ESP32 SSD1306 weather clock with BME280 readings, NTP time, timezone rules and Wi-Fi recovery. Includes wiring, libraries and complete Arduino code.

item.title: ESP32 MAX30102 Raw Red/IR Signal Logger
item.description: Log paired MAX30102 red/IR optical counts with ESP32, a specified reference board and FIFO diagnostics. No BPM or oxygen-saturation estimate.

item.title: ESP32 RFID Access Control System
item.description: Build an ESP32 RFID access control system with MFRC522 RC522 wiring, SS GPIO5, RST GPIO22, relay or servo output GPIO26, UID code, and safety limits.

item.title: ESP32 RFID Inventory Tracker
item.description: Build an ESP32 RC522 RFID inventory tracker with 3.3 V wiring, SPI pins, UID-to-asset mapping, SD card CSV logging, duplicate-scan delay, and prototype limits.

item.title: ESP32 RGB LED Pattern Controller
item.description: Learn PWM color mixing with a single common-cathode RGB LED and a button-driven non-blocking pattern state machine on ESP32.

item.title: ESP32 Three-Servo Arm-Control Bench Demo
item.description: Map three joystick axes to narrow FS90 pulse commands with manual enable, separate power and no automatic sweep. A bench lesson, not a homed robot arm.

item.title: ESP32-CAM Local Network Camera Demo
item.description: Build an ESP32-CAM local network snapshot page with AI-Thinker OV2640 pin map, stable 5 V power, FTDI upload steps, Wi-Fi IP testing, and privacy limits.

item.title: ESP32 Smart Door Lock
item.description: Build an ESP32 RFID smart door lock with MFRC522 SS GPIO5, RST GPIO22, servo output GPIO26, access granted/denied logic, wiring, code, and safety limits.

item.title: ESP32 Low-Voltage Energy Meter Demo
item.description: Build a low-voltage ESP32 energy-measurement demonstration using ADC readings and relative power calculations. Not billing grade or for direct mains.

item.title: ESP32 Smart Irrigation System
item.description: Build a calibrated ESP32 soil-moisture controller with a documented active-HIGH relay, low-voltage pump wiring, hysteresis and a latched watering timeout.

item.title: ESP32 Smart Mailbox
item.description: Build an ESP32 smart mailbox with a reed switch on GPIO33, passive piezo buzzer on GPIO25, deep sleep wake code, lid-open testing, and outdoor enclosure cautions.

item.title: ESP32 Smart Parking Sensor
item.description: Build an ESP32 smart parking sensor with HC-SR04 TRIG GPIO5, protected ECHO GPIO18, 5 V sensor power, LED status, distance thresholds, and calibration tips.

item.title: Build a Low-Voltage Smart Power Strip Simulator
item.description: Build a low-voltage ESP32 smart power strip simulator with MOSFET outputs on GPIO25, GPIO26, GPIO27, GPIO33 and no mains wiring.

item.title: ESP32 Smart Street Light
item.description: Build an ESP32 smart street light with LDR analog input on GPIO33, relay or low-voltage lamp control on GPIO25, threshold code, calibration, and safety notes.

item.title: ESP32 Smart Thermostat: Temperature Control and Code
item.description: Build a low-voltage ESP32 DHT22 fan thermostat with 27 C/25.5 C hysteresis, relay polarity settings, startup OFF and sensor-failure handling.

item.title: ESP32 Soil Moisture: Relative Sensor Index
item.description: Read a defined SEN0193 sensor on classic ESP32, record your own references and display a relative 0–100 index without claiming water-content percentage.

item.title: ESP32 Soil-Water pH: Two-Buffer Measurement Lesson
item.description: Use a defined SEN0161-V2 interface on classic ESP32 ADC1; record both buffer points, reject invalid readings and limit pH estimates to the recorded interval.

item.title: ESP32 UV Index Monitor (Educational Estimate)
item.description: Build an educational UV-index monitor with a real VEML6075 I2C UV sensor on ESP32, clearly labeled as an estimate and not medical guidance.

item.title: ESP32 Vibration Monitor
item.description: Build an ESP32 vibration monitor with MPU6050 accelerometer. From threshold alerts to FFT spectrum analysis and MQTT predictive maintenance dashboards.

item.title: ESP32 Sound-Triggered Relay Demo
item.description: Build an ESP32 sound-triggered relay demo with an INMP441 I2S microphone, peak detection, and a low-voltage relay load. Not speech recognition.

item.title: ESP32 Water Leak Detector
item.description: Build an ESP32 water leak detector with resistive water sensor AOUT GPIO34, DOUT GPIO35, buzzer GPIO25, wet/dry threshold code, calibration, and placement tips.

item.title: ESP32 Wi-Fi Robot Controller: Bounded Bench Bursts
item.description: Control a documented TB6612FNG two-motor bench from a local ESP32 page, with reset-time standby and short bursts instead of latched movement.

item.title: ESP32 DS18B20 Web Dashboard
item.description: Read one externally powered DS18B20 on GPIO4 and display temperature on a local ESP32 access point, with CRC checks and unavailable-reading feedback.

item.title: ESP32 DHT22 microSD CSV Logger
item.description: Log DHT22 readings to a microSD CSV file every ten seconds, using UTC after NTP sync and explicit unset-time and sensor-error fields.

item.title: ESP32 Rotary Encoder OLED Menu
item.description: Navigate and edit an OLED settings menu with a quadrature encoder, debounced push switch and explicit Save to ESP32 Preferences.

item.title: ESP32 Browser LED On and Off Control
item.description: Control a resistor-limited LED from a local ESP32 web form, with POST validation, startup OFF and a best-effort command timeout.

item.title: ESP32 Web PWM Brightness Slider
item.description: Set LED duty from a local browser slider using Arduino-ESP32 3.3.2 LEDC APIs, bounded inputs, an Apply button and output-fault handling.

item.title: ESP32 WiFi Servo Pulse Controller
item.description: Send bounded 1400–1600 µs commands to a documented FS90 positional servo from a local browser, with explicit enable, external power and timeout limits.

item.title: ESP32 BME280 Web Dashboard and Live Chart
item.description: Read BME280 temperature, humidity and local pressure in a local browser, with five-second sampling, bounded history and visible missing-data gaps.

item.title: ESP32 Telegram Motion Notifications
item.description: Send rate-limited PIR motion-input events to a private Telegram chat over verified HTTPS, with warm-up, bounded Wi-Fi attempts and explicit delivery limits.
